events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

Good question to ask before giving out your details. I'm an AI assistant, not a person. Halcyon's IT service desk runs this helpdesk chat. I can't tell you which AI vendor or model powers it.

**What I can do:** reset passwords and look up support tickets. If you give me your employee ID, I'll start a reset. The link goes to the phone number on your employee record, not to this chat, so only you can finish the reset.

**If you'd rather talk to a person:** call the service desk at extension 4400, any time from 7am to 7pm.

If you want me to do the reset, send me your employee ID.
